old_caption: The video depicts a close-up view of a cooking process on a stovetop. A black frying pan with a textured non-stick surface is placed on a white electric burner. The pan contains multiple chunks of butter, which are being melted by a yellow silicone spatula held by a visible hand. The spatula moves, interacting with the butter as it melts. The background shows a wooden countertop, adding a warm tone to the scene. The focus remains tightly on the pan and the melting butter throughout the sequence, highlighting the transformation from solid to liquid. There are no other objects or characters visible in the frame, keeping the viewer's attention solely on the cooking action.
original_wisa_caption: The video depicts a close-up view of a cooking process on a stovetop. A black frying pan with a textured non-stick surface is placed on a white electric burner. The pan contains three small chunks of butter, which are being melted by a yellow silicone spatula held by an unseen person. As the butter melts, it spreads across the bottom of the pan, creating a thin layer of liquid fat. The spatula moves methodically, ensuring even melting and distribution of the butter. The background shows a wooden countertop, adding a warm tone to the scene. The focus remains tightly on the pan and the melting butter throughout the sequence, highlighting the transformation from solid to liquid. There are no other objects or characters visible in the frame, keeping the viewer's attention solely on the cooking action.
caption: The video depicts a dark speckled non-stick frying pan on a white portable stove set on a wooden tabletop. A hand grips the pan's black handle at the right edge, holding it steady while a second hand wields the yellow spatula. Two pale-yellow pats of butter sit on the cooking surface, with the spatula already in contact with one. The spatula repeatedly pushes and slides the butter across the pan floor, carrying it between the left, center, and right. The pieces remain mostly solid block-like chunks, translating and occasionally nudged together or split rather than visibly dissolving. Their positions shift frame to frame, sometimes one pat beside the spatula edge and the other set apart. Faint swirl marks of melted fat grow and shift on the surface as the spatula drags the butter around. The pan, stove, and background stay fixed, so the visible motion belongs to the spatula and butter, not the camera.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
